settings.title: Get a 5% Rebate on your order!
Happy with your purchase?
settings.text:
At Canada Mats, your feedback is highly valued. In appreciation, we're offering a 5% rebate on your last order when you submit a video review for that product.

Requirements:

  • Format: Landscape preffered
  • Length: More than 2 Minutes

Content:

✅ Show the product in use.

✅ Share your honest thoughts and experience.

✅ Mention at least 2 specific features you liked.

✅ Offer any tips or advice for other customers.

Please note that Canada Mats will retain the rights to any video content being submitted and may use this in promotional and educational material. By agreeing to the terms and conditions above. You are agreeing to grant ownership of the content to Canada Mats.

Rebates are subject to approval of the submitted content and content rights will only be transferred to Canada Mats if a video is approved and rebate is provided. We will not use your content unless it meets our standards and a rebate is provided.

settings.title: How long will it take to receive my rebate?
settings.text: Please allow 3 - 5 business days for us to review your video

settings.title: Can I submit a review for multiple products?
settings.text:
Yes, the more the better!

Please keep in mind that this offer is applicable on a per order basis. So we can only send a 5% rebate per order. In special cases where you have ordered multiple kinds of products, please contact us to see if a larger rebate may be arranged.

settings.title: Does my video need to be approved?
settings.text: Yes each rebate is subject to approval based on the content and quality of the videos. We may ask for certain corrections before a rebate can be approved.

settings.title: If my review is declined, can I resubmit?
settings.text: Yes you can! We will also provide you feedback on how to make your video better!

settings.title: How will I know if my video has been approved?

settings.text: Help us enhance our products and services, and help other customers in making informed choices.
More questions? Reach out to sales@canadamats.ca and we will respond to you as soon as possible.
